title: 挑战 10 · 稳压电源 12V 点亮两颗白光 LED
summary: 把实验室电源调到 12V、限流 50mA，串联点亮两颗白光 LED。
description:
实验室直流稳压电源（bench supply）可以设定电压和限流（current limit）。电路正常时它工作在 CV（恒压）模式；如果接错导致电流超过限流值，它会进入 CC（恒流）模式，电压自动下降来保护电路。

要求：稳压电源 12V（限流设 50mA 作为保护），+12V → 330Ω → 白光 LED1 → 白光 LED2 → GND。
计算：两颗白光 LED 共 6.0V，电阻上 6V，粗算 I ≈ 6 / 330 ≈ 18mA；再算上两颗 LED 各约 12Ω 的内阻（第 3 课讲过），实际约 6 / (330 + 24) ≈ 17mA。远低于 50mA 限流，所以电源保持 CV 模式，输出稳稳的 12V。

想一想：如果不小心把电阻短路了（比如它两只脚插在同一列），电路里只剩两颗 LED 和它们的内阻（12 + 12 = 24Ω）：
- 没有限流时，电流会冲到 (12 − 6) / 24 ≈ 250mA，两颗 LED 都会烧坏。
- 限流设为 50mA 时，电源进入 CC 模式，把电流卡在 50mA，输出电压从 12V 降到约 7.2V。50mA 对 LED 来说仍然偏大，但不会烧掉——这就是限流保护，也是为什么做实验时限流要设小一点。

en.title: Challenge 10 · 12V bench supply lights two white LEDs
en.summary: Set the lab supply to 12V with a 50mA current limit and light two white LEDs in series.
en.description:
A lab DC bench power supply lets you set both a voltage and a current limit. When the circuit is working normally it runs in CV (constant voltage) mode; if a wiring mistake makes the current exceed the limit, it enters CC (constant current) mode and automatically lowers the voltage to protect the circuit.

Task: bench supply at 12V (current limit 50mA as protection), +12V → 330Ω → white LED1 → white LED2 → GND.
Calculation: the two white LEDs take 6.0V together, leaving 6V across the resistor, so the quick estimate is I ≈ 6 / 330 ≈ 18mA. Adding the two LEDs' internal resistance of about 12Ω each (see Lesson 3), the actual current is about 6 / (330 + 24) ≈ 17mA. That is well below the 50mA limit, so the supply stays in CV mode with a steady 12V output.

Think about it: if the resistor gets shorted out by accident (for example, both its leads in the same column), only the two LEDs and their internal resistance (12 + 12 = 24Ω) are left:
- With no current limit, the current would rush up to (12 − 6) / 24 ≈ 250mA and both LEDs would burn out.
- With the limit at 50mA, the supply switches to CC mode, holds the current at 50mA and its output drops from 12V to about 7.2V. 50mA is still too much for an LED, but it won't burn out. That is current-limit protection, and why you should set a low limit when experimenting.
hints: Select the bench supply, set its voltage to 12V and its current limit to 0.05A.
Red alligator clip (+) to the red rail, black (COM) to the blue rail.
The two LEDs are in series: LED1's short lead and LED2's long lead go in the same column.
tests: Both white LEDs on, supply holds 12V (CV mode)
